citazioni: (S)-(+)-2-(6-Methoxy-2-naphthyl)propionic acid ((S)-(+)-naproxen, 99%) was purchased from Alfa Aesar.
All of the APIs were used without further puriﬁcation.

Both (S)-(+)-ibuprofen (206.3 mg, 1 mmol) and (S)-(−)-1phenylethylamine or (R)-(+)-1-phenylethylamine (129 μL, 1.0 mmol) were dissolved in 6 mL of a 67% ethanol/water mixture by heating at 60 °C for a minute under magnetic stirring. The solution was cooled to rt, and some of the solvent was allowed to evaporate. After 24 h, the formation of colorless needles was observed.
All syntheses were carried out in air at room temperature (rt)
In all cases, slow solvent evaporation resulted in SCXRD-quality crystals.

preparazioni.note: Un'unica sintesi per i due diastereoisomeri (S-PEA o R-PEA). Aghi incolori. Quantita' e rese nell'extra.

citazioni: Both (S)-(+)-naproxen (230.3 mg, 1 mmol) and (S)-(−)-1-phenylethylamine or (R)-(+)-1-phenylethylamine (129 μL, 1.0 mmol) were solubilized together under magnetic stirring in 15 mL of a 70% ethanol/water mixture. Stirring was ceased upon observing the complete dissolution of both reagents, the system was stored at rt, and the vial was sealed with punctured Paraﬁlm. The salts were obtained as colorless needles after partial solvent evaporation at rt for 7 days.
In all cases, slow solvent evaporation resulted in SCXRD-quality crystals.
